name: Rolls
description: The first clip rolls away around a corner, revealing the second. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: corner
params.description: Corner to roll around: 0 bottom right, 1 bottom left, 2 top left, 3 top right

params.name: roll_down
params.description: Roll the first clip down instead of up
